Maya (CS): Heads-up — Sundial Labs hit a 62% weekly usage drop. Renewal in 6 weeks. Promo email from competitor spotted last week. Can we triage?
Jamal (AM): ack. Do we know if this is traffic-related or feature fit?
Maya (CS): initial signal: top 3 active projects dropped. Customer mentioned 'trying an alternative for faster fine-tuning' in last call.
Priya (Solutions): any diffs in error rates or latency in the last 14 days?
Alex (Support): looked at alerts — no elevated 5xx spikes. Token usage per-request is down; calls per minute down ~55%.
Evan (Eng): I'll run a quick prefix-usage query against prod metrics. Pasting query: ```SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) as calls, AVG(latency_ms) FROM requests WHERE org='sundial' AND timestamp > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY team_id;```
Maya (CS): thanks Evan. Also note their CTO (external) accepted a speaking slot with the competitor last month — possible influence.
Jamal (AM): renewal owner flagged. What's our playbook? Do we try a CTO-level technical deep-dive or a commercial move (credits/extended trial)?
Priya (Solutions): recommend two-track: 1) urgent technical touchpoint to surface migration friction, 2) a commercial bridge (1 month free Dedicated trial or onboarding credit) while we investigate.
Maya (CS): agree. Customer is on Hosted plan; Dedicated pitch might be premature but they care about fine-tuning latency and private models.
Alex (Support): I can open a dedicated support ticket offering a performance audit. Send me the list of affected projects.
Maya (CS): will assemble affected project IDs and recent activity. Evan — any quick wins on observability we can offer in the audit?
Evan (Eng): we can show KV cache hit rates, batching inefficiencies, and model variant suggestions. I can prepare a short slide w/ numbers by EOD.
Jamal (AM): I'll queue an exec check-in ask for next week; need to know who the new champion is now. Maya — can you book intro with their new ML lead?
Maya (CS): pinged them earlier today; awaiting reply. I'll follow up and propose the two-track plan.
Priya (Solutions): playbook snippets: 1) run "migration friction checklist" during technical deep-dive 2) propose quantization/variant that cuts cost but keeps accuracy 3) offer a 4-week Dedicated trial if they commit to a POC measurement window.
Maya (CS): nice. Jamal — any guardrails on offering Dedicated trial vs discounts?
Jamal (AM): no unilateral Dedicated commits >$5k/month. If we offer trial, approvals needed from sales ops. I'll pre-approve the outreach; if they accept, escalate for promo sign-off.
Maya (CS): action items: Maya assemble project list + outreach; Evan deliver obs slides; Alex open support audit ticket; Priya prep checklist; Jamal start approval thread. I'll update this thread after customer reply.
sentry-bot: Alert resolved for sundial: weekly usage anomaly acknowledged by CS team. :white_check_mark:
